description: This file defines the IRuntimeManager interface and related structures for managing runtime containers, including lifecycle operations, notifications, and configuration settings.

classes.name: RuntimeConfig
classes.description: Configuration structure for runtime environment settings.

classes.name: IRuntimeManager
classes.description: Interface for managing runtime containers, including lifecycle and notification handling.

classes.name: IRuntimeManager::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for runtime container events such as start, terminate, failure, and state change.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Start a runtime container with specified configuration.

methods.name: Wake
methods.description: Wake a container to a specified runtime state.

methods.name: Annotate
methods.description: Send annotations to Dobby for a container.

methods.name: Mount
methods.description: Mount a host directory/device inside a container.

methods.name: Unmount
methods.description: Unmount a directory/device inside a container.
